greeting.speaker: Codge the Village Idiot
text: They call me the idiot because I count the boats. Nobody else counts the boats. Nine went out. Nine is wrong.
Don't stand there, that's where I count from. Nine went out. It's still wrong.
You've come at the wrong tide for talking and the right one for counting. Nine. Wrong.

options.text: Who told you to stop counting?
You're not wrong. Say it slower and say it to me.

again.speaker: Codge the Village Idiot
text: You came back and you didn't tell me to stop. I've written that down. Not on anything. In my head.
Still nine. I checked at first light and I checked at slack and it's still nine.
The others walk round me. You walk up to me. I count that too.

options.text: Show me where the shingle is scraped smooth.

nine_is_wrong.speaker: Codge the Village Idiot
nine_is_wrong.text: Nine went out. Ten came back. Nobody wants that arithmetic so they gave it to me and told me to stop doing it.

the_count.speaker: Codge the Village Idiot
the_count.text: Nine. Always nine. I know every keel by the noise it makes on the shingle and one of them makes no noise at all.

he_trusts_you.speaker: Codge the Village Idiot
he_trusts_you.text: ...The tenth comes in on the slack and goes out before the light. It ties up where the shingle is scraped smooth. You've walked past it already.

he_shuts_up.speaker: Codge the Village Idiot
he_shuts_up.text: No. No, I'm the idiot. Ask the ones who can read.

the_meal.speaker: Codge the Village Idiot
the_meal.text: You didn't tell me to stop counting first. Nobody does that.

who_stopped_him.speaker: Codge the Village Idiot
who_stopped_him.text: The headman. He said the number frightens the women. It doesn't. It frightens him. I know the difference, I count that too.

todays_count.speaker: Codge the Village Idiot
text: Nine out. Nine back. And a keel that made no noise, so that's ten, so that's wrong.
Eight out. One didn't go. He didn't say why and I didn't ask, because asking makes them stop telling.
Nine, nine, nine, and a rope tied by somebody who isn't from here.

the_scrape.speaker: Codge the Village Idiot
the_scrape.text: Past the last net pole, where the shingle goes flat and quiet. Don't go at slack. Go now, when whoever it belongs to is asleep somewhere warm.
